cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)

# 1. Project name and version
project(V_Arcade VERSION 1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

# 2. Set C++ standard to 17
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# 3. Include directories (where your .h files are)
include_directories(include)

# 4. Find all source files
# We separate .cpp files and the .c file for clarity
file(GLOB CPP_SOURCES "src/*.cpp")
set(SQLITE_SOURCE "src/sqlite3.c")

# 5. Create the executable
add_executable(Game ${CPP_SOURCES} ${SQLITE_SOURCE})

# 6. Link libraries based on the OS
# This is where CMake shines for cross-platform support
if(UNIX)
    # Linux and macOS need these for SQLite
    target_link_libraries(Game pthread dl)
endif()

# Optional: Organize build output to a 'bin' folder
set_target_properties(Game PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}../../build")
